level.why: 賣場廣播單一主題，時間與原因照字面出現。

script.t: Excuse me, shoppers, we have a quick announcement from the Fresh Mart customer service desk.
script.zh: 各位顧客請注意，Fresh Mart 客服櫃檯有一則簡短廣播。

script.t: Our store will close at six o'clock tonight instead of ten o'clock.
script.zh: 本店今晚將在六點打烊，而不是十點。

script.t: We need extra time to change the price tags for tomorrow's big sale.
script.zh: 我們需要額外時間更換明天大特賣的價格標籤。

script.t: Please bring your items to the checkout counters by five forty-five.
script.zh: 請在五點四十五分前把商品帶到結帳櫃檯。

script.t: The bakery and the pharmacy will also close at six.
script.zh: 麵包坊和藥局也會在六點關門。

script.t: We will reopen at eight tomorrow morning with lower prices.
script.zh: 我們明天早上八點重新營業，價格會更低。

script.t: We are sorry for any trouble this may cause.
script.zh: 對於可能造成的不便，我們深表歉意。

script.t: Thank you for shopping at Fresh Mart.
script.zh: 感謝您在 Fresh Mart 購物。

q.t: Who most likely is the speaker?

choices.why: 正解：from the Fresh Mart customer service desk。
說話者是對顧客廣播，不是顧客。
藥局只是同樣提早關門的區域。

q.t: What is the announcement mainly about?
q.zh: 這則廣播主要與什麼有關？

choices.t: A change in the store's closing time
choices.why: 正解：六點打烊而不是十點。

choices.t: The opening of a new bakery
choices.why: 麵包坊只是同樣提早關門。
大特賣是隔天的事，且不是主旨。

choices.t: A lost item at the checkout

q.t: Why does the store need extra time?
q.zh: 商店為什麼需要額外時間？

choices.t: To update prices for a sale
choices.why: 正解：change the price tags → update prices。

tag: 平板電腦取貨通知留言

level.why: 電話留言內容單純，取貨期限與聯絡方式照字面出現。

script.t: This message is for Ms. Lopez. I am calling from City Electronics on Grand Avenue.
script.zh: 這是留給 Lopez 小姐的訊息。我從大街上的 City Electronics 來電。

script.t: The tablet you ordered last week has arrived at our store.
script.zh: 您上週訂的平板電腦已經到我們店裡了。

script.t: You can pick it up any day from nine a.m. to eight p.m.
script.zh: 您可以每天上午九點到晚上八點來取貨。

script.t: Please bring your photo ID and the order receipt.
script.zh: 請帶您的附照片證件和訂購收據。

script.t: We will keep the tablet for you until Saturday.
script.zh: 我們會幫您保留平板電腦到週六。

script.t: After that, we will put it back on the shelf for other customers.
script.zh: 之後我們會把它放回架上給其他顧客。

script.t: If you need more time, please call us at 555-0134.
script.zh: 如果您需要更多時間，請撥 555-0134 給我們。

script.t: Thank you, and we look forward to seeing you.
script.zh: 謝謝您，期待您的光臨。

choices.t: To say an order is ready for pickup
choices.zh: 告知訂購商品可以取貨
choices.why: 正解：the tablet you ordered has arrived → pick it up。

choices.t: To offer a discount on tablets

choices.why: 說話者是通知取貨，不是退貨。

q.t: What will probably happen if Ms. Lopez does not come by Saturday?
q.zh: 如果 Lopez 小姐週六前沒來，可能會發生什麼事？

choices.t: The tablet may be offered to other customers.
choices.zh: 平板電腦可能會提供給其他顧客。
choices.why: 正解：put it back on the shelf for other customers。

choices.t: The tablet will be shipped to her home.
The tablet will be held until Sunday.
choices.zh: 平板電腦會保留到週日。

q.t: What should Ms. Lopez do if she needs more time?
q.zh: 如果 Lopez 小姐需要更多時間，應該怎麼做？

choices.why: 證件是取貨時要帶的東西。

level.why: 廣告折扣、條件與贈品照字面出現。

script.t: Back to school means new shoes, and Step Right Shoes has the best deals in town!
script.zh: 開學季就是要買新鞋，Step Right Shoes 有全城最划算的優惠！

script.t: From Friday to Sunday, all children's sneakers are thirty percent off.
script.zh: 週五到週日，所有兒童運動鞋打七折。

script.t: Adult sneakers are twenty percent off during the same three days.
script.zh: 成人運動鞋在同樣三天打八折。

script.t: Spend over sixty dollars, and you will get a free pair of socks.
script.zh: 消費超過六十美元，就送一雙免費襪子。

script.t: Our friendly staff can measure your child's feet for free.
script.zh: 我們親切的店員可以免費幫您的孩子量腳。

script.t: Come early on Friday, because the first fifty customers will also receive a free backpack.
script.zh: 週五請早點來，因為前五十位顧客還可獲贈免費背包。

script.t: We are located next to the City Library, and parking is free.
script.zh: 我們位於市立圖書館旁邊，停車免費。

script.t: Step Right Shoes: the right fit at the right price!
script.zh: Step Right Shoes：合適的尺寸，合適的價格！

q.t: What can be inferred about the sale?
q.zh: 關於這場特賣可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: It is aimed at families preparing for school.
choices.why: 正解：Back to school 與兒童運動鞋折扣。

choices.t: It is only for adult shoppers.
choices.why: 兒童運動鞋折扣更高，成人也有折扣。

choices.t: It lasts for the whole month.
It is held at the library.
choices.why: 圖書館只是店鋪位置的參照點。

q.t: What must customers do to get free socks?
q.zh: 顧客要怎麼做才能得到免費襪子？

choices.why: 週五早到是為了拿背包。

q.t: What does the speaker imply when she says, "Come early on Friday, because the first fifty customers will also receive a free backpack."?
q.zh: 說話者說「Come early on Friday, because the first fifty customers will also receive a free backpack.」是暗示什麼？

choices.why: 正解：前五十位才有背包，所以要早到。

choices.t: The store opens at six in the morning.
Staff will explain how to measure feet.
